language.name: C#

packageAssets: Microsoft.AspNetCore.App net11.0; matching SDK Internal.Assets browser files
prerequisites: Use Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web, net11.0, nullable and implicit usings. Register AddInteractiveServerComponents and AddInteractiveServerRenderMode, activate the interactive component and load blazor.web.js. No separate Virtualize package, database provider or optional workload.

Use a finite-height vertical scroll container with one full-width block per item. Keep spacers in the same vertical stack. Native IntersectionObserver and ResizeObserver must receive real layout notifications.
constraints: Interactive Virtualize; prepend/append behaviour and browser/layout differences require consumer testing. Static SSR/prerender alone cannot maintain a live viewport.
Choose Start, End, None or combined flags explicitly. Start follows prepends only near the head; End follows appends only near the tail. Scrolled-away readers retain their item/offset.

Compare fresh provider instances by unique immutable ID; use @key separately for component identity. Retained UI state lasts only while the row remains rendered. Refresh provider data after mutations; preserve order and accurate total counts.

Variable heights use measured averages and spacer estimates. OverscanCount=15 is deliberate and differs from QuickGrid's default 3; increasing it costs DOM/render work. Avoid layout transforms, nonvertical stacks and competing custom scroll compensation.
The .NET 10 bounded nonvirtualized comparison is compiled/executed, not an older-target route for the new API. No WebAssembly/Auto, table/Safari, other-platform or GA execution is claimed.
